lead.headline: South Dakota State is 4-0 and won at Kansas State
lead.deck: The Jackrabbits rate 90th in our model, far ahead of the rest of an eight-team league.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the Summit League, eight schools from Grand Forks and St. Paul down to Kansas City and Tulsa. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
South Dakota State opened with a 68-66 win at Kansas State and hasn't lost since. The Jackrabbits beat Valparaiso 81-69 and Northern Colorado 71-46 on a neutral floor Saturday.
St. Thomas rates second in the league at 177th. The Tommies won at Presbyterian and lost 79-77 at Army on Saturday.
North Dakota State beat Illinois State 82-81 in overtime on Friday after three straight road losses out West.
Omaha has won two straight, including 67-56 over Lindenwood on Friday.

body: **1.** Summit team in our national top 175. South Dakota State is 90th.

notes.body: The Roos beat Southern Illinois 100-93, then went 1-2 in Florida.

notes.headline: North Dakota on the road
notes.body: The Fighting Hawks won 93-90 at Winthrop and lost at Minnesota and Clemson.

notes.headline: Oral Roberts bounces back
notes.body: The Golden Eagles beat Oklahoma City 82-39 on Saturday.

notes.headline: One bid
notes.body: The Summit League tournament in March decides the league's NCAA bid.
